title: The register's history, .sheepdog/seams-history.json
description: How many seams there were on each day seams render --record ran, and how many at each rung, so a team sees whether coverage keeps pace as seams grow.

date.description: The day, in UTC; one count a day, the last recorded.

rungs.description: How many seams were at each rung, 0 to 6, when a status file was given.

unrated.description: How many seams the status file didn't rate; given whenever rungs is.
